issues.title: Update planning messages for consistency across strike and others.
issues.body:
For most activities (templates) we store the ids & number for own assets, and the the id for op-for assets.

For STRIKE activities we store different own/opp asset data.  For own assets we id, number, missileType, for op-for we store id and number.

We store both of the above under one PlanningMessage type.

We can fix this by switching the op-for to be a table of asset ids.  It will cosmetically look the same to the player, but we'll have a consistent structure.

Note: we'll also have to update the customiser, to generate asset ids in the same way for own and op-for assets.

Also, capture a couple of new orders, and check that we render/hide the fields as relevant.

* [x] update planning message type
* [x] generate new mock messages (bulk and plain set)
* [x] put new messages into SQLite database
